DISCOVERY 301, DEFENDANTS DAVID MENG AND DAVID C. MENG, DDS, INCORPORATED'S MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION IS DENIED. THE INDICATION THAT THE MOTION WOULD GO OFF CALENDAR WAS ONLY A TENTATIVE RULING AS TO WHICH THE MOVING PARTY GAVE TIMELY NOTICE HE WOULD APPEAR TO CONTEST. DEFENDANTS CAN NOT NOW CONTEST THE MERITS OF A MOTION THEY CHOSE NOT TO OPPOSE OR TO ARGUE. NEEDLESS TO SAY, IF DEFENDANTS HAVE ALREADY FULFILLED THEIR OBLIGATIONS UNDER THE ORDER, THEN THE ORDER IS TO THAT EXTENT SATISFIED. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER.
